kjv: they (Ephraim and Judah) like men have transgressed the covenant
mine: like Adam they (Ephraim and Judah) transgressed the covenant
note: ke'adam can be "like Adam" (the first covenant-breaker), "like humans", or (emended be'adam) the town of Adam, which suits the following "there"; KJV's "like men" is the weakest reading.
